AudioSettingsMsg.description: M11.2: set the shared screen's audio (any seated player, last write wins).
AudioSettingsMsg.title: AudioSettingsMsg

DefeatRetry.description: M11.1: after a party wipe, go back to the last checkpoint (host or the sole player).
DefeatRetry.title: DefeatRetry

Give.description:
Hand something to an NPC who is here: `item_id` is an inventory item key, or (M23.3) the id
of a keepsake the hero carries (a quest item is delivered this way).
Give.title: Give

HostTurnTimer.description: M15.1: the host's combat turn timer in seconds (0 = off).
HostTurnTimer.title: HostTurnTimer

Presented.description:
M26.3: the screen's show queue has shown everything up to `seq` (the highest `seq` of an
event line or dice roll it finished). Only screens count; a player's is ignored.
Presented.title: Presented

ScribeRevive.description: M13.1: pay the Scribe (from the sender's own hero) to rewrite a fallen hero.
ScribeRevive.title: ScribeRevive

ScribeSkip.description: M13.2: the host skips the Scribe's current line (`line_id` optional, else the last one).
ScribeSkip.title: ScribeSkip

Typing.description: M11.2: the player is composing (`on`) or stopped; expires on the server after ~8 s.
Typing.title: Typing

AudioSettings.description: The shared screen's audio (M11.2): set by any seated player, last write wins.
AudioSettings.title: AudioSettings

CharacterExport.description: The player's hero as a character JSON document (`rules.character_io` format).
CharacterExport.title: CharacterExport

outcome.description: how the fight ended (only with combat None; M15.1)

target.description: DC or AC when the roll is a test
target.title: Target

FloorSeat.description: One player on the floor line: `position` is 1-based in the waiting queue (0 otherwise).
FloorSeat.title: FloorSeat

FloorView.description:
Out of combat: `holder` is the player whose action is resolving (in combat: the owner of
the active hero); `queue` waits in order (`queue[0]` is next); `typing` are composing now.

seconds_left.description: seconds left on the running turn timer (M15.1)
seconds_left.title: Seconds Left

FloorView.title: FloorView

KeepsakeLine.description:
A story object the hero carries (M19.3): no value, cannot be sold or equipped. A quest
item (M23.3) names the quest it belongs to in `quest_title`.
KeepsakeLine.title: KeepsakeLine

PlayerActionMsg.description:
M22.1: a player's typed action as it starts to play out (`entry.kind == "action"`); the
screen shows the words with the hero's portrait and the player's name before the telling.
PlayerActionMsg.title: PlayerActionMsg

PublicFinale.description:
M23.9: the plan's finale question. `chosen` is None while the party must still choose
(the card shows); afterwards it is the chosen ending's id and `ending` its text.
PublicFinale.title: PublicFinale

PublicNpcView.description: What a client may see of an NPC: never the motive or an unrevealed secret (SPEC 9).
PublicNpcView.title: PublicNpcView

PublicQuest.description:
A quest line (M23.7). Only the texts of DONE steps are sent, never the next one (that is
the answer to "What now?"). `closed_reason` is "", "left_behind" or "withdrawn"; `routes` are
the known routes of a main quest.
PublicQuest.title: PublicQuest

PublicRoute.description: A known way through a main quest (M23.7): only the steps already done are named.
PublicRoute.title: PublicRoute

PublicScene.description:
The party's place. `terrain` is its first terrain tag (art key `region_banner.<terrain>`,
the phone's Play picture and the screen header, M24), "" when unknown.
PublicScene.title: PublicScene

turn_timer.description: the host's turn timer in seconds, 0 = off
turn_timer.title: Turn Timer

PublicZone.description:
A battlefield zone for the zone card; `terrain` is the terrain template (art key
`zone_card.<terrain>`) the zone came from, "" when unknown.
`difficult` is the base terrain flag; `rough` is the effective one (terrain or a difficult
surface) that doubles the cost of entering the zone. `q`, `r` are its axial hex on the battle
map (M21: touching hexes are linked zones; `aidm.rules.hex_layout`).
PublicZone.title: PublicZone

RollEntry.description: One recent dice roll of the story history (restores the dice panel on reconnect).
RollEntry.title: RollEntry

ScribeLineMsg.description:
M13.2: the Scribe speaks one line of data/voice/scribe.json (picked by the server).

Broadcast to every connection. `to_player_id` names the addressee of a refusal (the screen
still voices it; other phones show nothing); null = everyone. `audio_url` is "" until the
voice build has made that line's file.
ScribeLineMsg.title: ScribeLineMsg

ScribeSkipMsg.description: M13.2: the host skipped the Scribe: stop his audio and overlay (`line_id` = the line).
ScribeSkipMsg.title: ScribeSkipMsg

SheetMsg.description:
The asker's own derived sheet (`request_sheet`), plus what the next level asks when the
hero can level up now (`level_up`).
SheetMsg.title: SheetMsg

StoryEntry.description:
One line of the story history: a told narration (id, tone), a public event line, or a
player's typed action (M22.1: `text` is their words; who typed it and for which hero).
StoryEntry.title: StoryEntry

StoryHistory.description:
The recent story (narration and public event lines, oldest first), sent after a snapshot,
plus the recent dice rolls (oldest first).
StoryHistory.title: StoryHistory

WhatNowAnswer.description:
M23.8: the engine's answer to What now? (`aidm.rules.quest_hints`), sent to the asker's
phone and to the shared screens; `asked_by` is the asker's seat name.
WhatNowAnswer.title: WhatNowAnswer
